newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei plunges below key 19,000 level by end.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei plunges below key 19,000 level by end.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market's key index closed below the key psychological level of 19,000 on Tuesday.
Despite the yen's recovery against the dollar and Wall Street's rally to all-time highs overnight, the market was beset by lingering worries over the economy.
